inference.cluster_policy: Resample complete nested-p seed trajectories independently within each lattice size.
inference.crossing_policy: Retain no-crossing and multiple-crossing bootstrap outcomes. Quote a conditional crossing interval only when exactly one directed crossing is present; always report its topology support.
inference.cell_sign_policy: Classify an adjacent-size LER difference only when its central 90% bootstrap interval excludes zero.
inference.refinement_policy: Add p midpoints where the 90% interval for LER(smaller)-LER(larger) includes zero or where conditional crossing intervals are wider than 0.01; preserve the full q=0:0.05:1 skeleton.
inference.promotion_gate: No single p_c(q) is promoted unless both L7/L9 and L9/L11 have single-crossing support at least 0.90, compatible conditional 90% intervals, and the reported interval width is at most 0.01.

provenance_policy: Every shard must use one identical runtime/source cohort and pass syndrome fidelity plus start/end source-hash equality. Never pool the legacy synchronous-40 q-skeleton or earlier residual-80 pilots into this campaign.
execution_gate: Completed all 21 shards and 693000 raw observations on 2026-08-28. Every shard passed syndrome fidelity, gzip/SHA-256 integrity, and start/end source stability; the final runner/dispatcher/analyzer/recovery suite passed 19/19 tests.
purpose: Researcher-selected honeycomb-first full q=0:0.05:1 discovery at L=7,9,11, followed by fluctuation-aware adaptive p refinement. Square remains explicitly deferred.
